dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Nothing here's particularly rare or valuable. Just take your pick.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: What's up? Taken an interest into these little bits and bobs? Well, let me be clear, they can't be modified into anything remotely close to military-grade.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Could you tell from my voice, or did someone tell you? If it's the former, then I gotta say, you've got a sharp pair of ears.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: That's right, I'm from Snezhnaya. But right now, I'm just a shopkeeper carving out a living in Nasha Town. Nothing more, nothing less.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Compared to my icy hometown, I'm more used to the climate here... and the people. Their thoughts aren't quite as tangled up, and even their lies are, all in all, rather... simple.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Stay safe. If you need anything, you know where to find me.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: The type that the Fatui love to cram full of weapons. To twist technology meant to serve humanity into tools for evil... What a waste of genius. What an utterly fatuous farce, perfectly befitting their organization's name.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: These mechanisms here can't be modified that way — or rather, the cost of doing so would exceed that of building a new one from scratch. They're strictly limited to domestic purposes, so think carefully before buying one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm just a little curious.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: That's alright. If you want one, pick one. If you don't, then just keep looking.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know anything about the Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Why are you asking me? I've got nothing in common with those cowa... Ahem, I mean, those mask-wearing creeps who skulk around all day.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Or did you hear some droll rumors accusing me of being a Snezhnayan spy? Pff. You'd be underestimating the Snezhnayan intelligence agencies, and you'd be underestimating me.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Anyways. They do their dirty work, and I do my business. That's all. Don't go lumping us together just because we're both from Snezhnaya.
